product.schneider-386-60-16.summary: The 16 MHz 80386 in the 1989 German range.
product.schneider-386-60-16.history: The June 1989 German list advertised the 386-60/16 for DM 7,990 net.
product.schneider-386-60-16.technical.co: Disk capacity changed between lists. It appeared with 60 MB in 1989 and 68 MB in April 1990. The June 1989 table lists 2 MB RAM and the December detailed entry lists 1 MB.
product.schneider-386-60-16.technical.ve: The offer is documented. A dedicated model and boot validation in BluMach remain pending.
product.schneider-386-60-16.technical.li: The board still needs to be matched, an attributable BIOS needs preservation and an image with clear publication rights remains pending.
